command: set -euo pipefail; echo ADMISSION_REFRESH; uptime; free -m; echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum buehne.html|awk '{print $1}'); echo AVATAR_SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service || true); echo PROD_CHROME_COUNT=$(pgrep -a -f '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' | grep -v -- '--type=' | grep -v 'bash -lc' | wc -l); echo TOP_CPU; ps -eo pid,pcpu,pmem,comm,args --sort=-pcpu | head -n 12; echo ADMISSION_REFRESH_PASS
